vis.alt: Enterohepatic circulation of bile acids: liver makes bile, gallbladder stores it, cholecystokinin contracts the gallbladder to release it into the duodenum, bile acids form micelles with fat, and about 95 percent is reabsorbed in the terminal ileum and returned to the liver by the portal vein.
vis.caption: Bile acids are recycled: ileal reabsorption returns most of the pool to the liver. Ileal disease causes bile acid malabsorption.
